scope: Implement the existing-plan fast validation slice separating DXF MESH wire/typed-topology preservation from open-surface and closed-solid geometry expectations.

generatedControls.name: open-quad
generatedControls.expectedDisposition: native MESH and exact open cage topology retained; not a closed solid

generatedControls.name: concave-pentagon
generatedControls.expectedDisposition: one concave n-gon face with all five ordered vertex indices retained; no PFACE/3DFACE fallback

generatedControls.name: closed-box-2x3x4
generatedControls.expectedDisposition: closed oriented cage; independently authored area 52 and signed volume 24

assertions: one native MESH record and one AcDbSubDMesh subclass marker
following LINE framing survives output and readback
typed readback equals authored version, flags, vertices, face order, explicit edges, crease values, and property overrides
undirected edge incidence and orientation distinguish open controls from the closed box
decoded closed-box metrics match authored area and volume
limitations: The new scanner checks raw entity identity/subclass and following-record framing; topology values are compared through typed readback, not a second full raw group-code grammar scanner.
The closedness/area/volume check is a generated analytic control, not an independent CAD-kernel result.
No subdivision-surface evaluation, DWG MESH layout, nonempty DWG override mapping, external peer, native CAD, or consumer qualification was performed.
implementation.temporaryArtifacts: Generated ASCII/binary DXFs are written to the system temporary directory and removed after each case; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
